title: The Ironclad wins at ascension 20
line: The network ironclad-runs-habits-10 clears the hardest difficulty on seed L7WC, beats both final bosses and ends at full HP.

title: The Watcher's first Heart win at ascension 20
line: watcher-runs-1-lower-lr (update 700) takes the three keys, beats both Act 3 bosses and then the Heart at ascension 20 on seed 6ZWI, finishing it on 13 HP: the Watcher network's first A20 Heart win, one night into its training.

title: The Silent wins at ascension 20
line: The Silent's network silent-runs-5 (update 800) wins its first A20 run, on seed 70ES, with Kunai and Akabeko.

title: The Silent's first network wins
line: silent-runs-1 at update 110, a few hours into its training, wins at ascension 0 on seed 706Y.

title: An early Ironclad win
line: One of the first Ironclad networks wins at ascension 0 (seed 6ZXB), with Sacred Bark doubling its potions.

title: A 41-card Ironclad deck
line: An Ironclad network wins at ascension 0 (seed 87XNM) carrying a big deck, Sozu and Mark of Pain.
